d: Fives Services Gulf is actively seeking an Execution Director to join its teams in the Gulf region.
At Fives, we are all driven by a common calling, to prove that industry can do it!
We work together daily to make industry an answer to all of the major technological, environmental, social and economic challenges of our time.
For over 200 years, we’ve invented and designed solutions and technologies that substantially and sustainably improve everyone’s daily life.

Fives Services Gulf is the Fives service Centre for the Middle East, with a team of 160 people based in Bahrain, UAE and Saudi Arabia, Fives Services Gulf provides local customer service, project execution support and local parts sourcing, in addition to carrying out refit and modernization projects, audits and technical assistance on customer sites. A team is also dedicated to the maintenance of equipment in operation at our customers' plants.

We are committed, fulfilled and give meaning to our mission, which is to work together to develop new solutions for the industry of tomorrow: an industry that respects the environment and helps to make the world a better place.
It is with you, that industry can do it!

Fives Services Gulf (FSG) is recruiting for an experienced Execution Director to lead the delivery of Engineering, Supply Chain activities and Projects related to Fives Services Gulf. The position will oversee the project, engineering and supply chain teams located in Bahrain and the UAE.

The role requires a strong leader capable of managing technical project execution, overseeing the delivery of all projects and operational activities in alignment with FSG’s strategic and operational objectives. This role holds full accountability for Engineering, Supply Chain and Project Execution within Fives Services Gulf. The position requires managing multiple complex projects simultaneously, often with overlapping timelines and varying client and technical requirements.
This position reports directly to the Managing Director for the Gulf Region and plays a critical role in connecting sales, projects, spare parts and HSEQ across the Gulf region.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (Master’s degree preferred).
10+ years of experience in project execution and engineering services, preferably in the aluminum or heavy industrial sectors.
Proven leadership experience managing distributed teams.
Strong understanding of project execution services and customer support in an aluminum industry setting (Potroom cranes and Green Anode Plant).
Ability to manage cross-border operations and frequent travel between the UAE and Bahrain (50/50 time split).
Fluent in English; French proficiency is an advantage.
Frequent regional/international travel will be required.

By becoming part of Fives, you will join an international group offering access to a wide range of growth and mobility opportunities. We provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and develop both professionally and personally.
r: Provide strategic direction and technical oversight for all engineering activities to ensure alignment with project requirements, safety standards, and client specifications.
Ensure manuals and technical documents are regularly updated and shared to equip users with the necessary knowledge to execute tasks safely and efficiently.
Identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities within engineering workflows to enhance productivity and quality.
Foster a strong relationship with the Product Offices Engineering teams (based abroad).

Identify areas for automation and digitization to drive efficiencies in day-to-day working practices and lead the implementation of automation/digitization strategies and solutions for the Execution department to drive continuous improvement and enhance the department’s capabilities and service offering.
Responsible for overseeing the execution of projects and ensuring delivery is in line with the technical scope, specifications, budgets, timelines, and regulatory standards.
Oversee the project execution teams based in the Gulf, ensuring effective remote collaboration.
Ensure project activities align with customer expectations, FSG safety standards and quality requirements.
Collaborate with spare parts and workshop teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
Oversee purchasing and logistics for Fives Services Gulf, ensuring spare parts procurement and delivery align with operational and strategic requirements.
Manage stock requirements, inventory, replenishment, and availability of resources to support operational needs.
Participate in the development of quotations, bids, and technical evaluations to support tendering and bidding processes.
Develop strategies to ensure the department meets operational requirements to support company objectives.

Responsible for defining, developing and implementing the operating framework and policies and procedures for the Execution Department and ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, Fives standards and international best practices.

Responsible for overseeing the planning, scheduling and execution of daily operations of the department to ensure that work/tasks are performed accurately and efficiently in conformance with established methods, instructions and quality standards, and results are reported in a timely manner as per Company policies and procedures and/or customer requirements.
Develop and create the required strategies to ensure the department can meet the operational requirements of Fives Services Gulf to support achievement of operational and strategic objectives.
Responsible for managing, reviewing and monitoring the financial performance of the department including but not limited to managing the P&L and developing CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
Participate in the candidate selection process and ensure all recruitment activities within area of responsibility are completed as per Fives Services Gulf recruitment policies and procedures.
Set and agree individual goals for all direct reports and evaluate individual performance providing regular feedback and coaching in line with Fives people management practices.
Ensure compliance with all relevant (internal and external) regulations including HSEQ requirements using Company policies and procedures as appropriate.

Responsible for developing and implementing plans for cost reduction and driving efficient and effective practices and procedures to continuously improve and enhance the department’s capabilities and operations.
Establish and maintain a strong rapport with key customers in the Gulf.
Act as the primary point of contact for customers in the UAE regarding project execution and service delivery.
Working closely with the sales team, support business development efforts by identifying local opportunities and ensuring customer satisfaction.
Represent the company in local meetings, technical discussions, and commercial negotiations.

Direct reports include Project Supervisors, Project Managers and other project execution roles. Dotted line reports include Business Development Managers, Spare Part Coordinators, HR Roles and administrative staff.
Foster a strong team spirit, ensuring collaboration across functions and a sense of belonging.
Ensure effective communication and integration between the project team located in the Gulf.
Provide regular updates and performance reports on projects, team activities, and customer relations.
Successful and timely execution of projects and engineering services across FSG operations.
Customer satisfaction and relationship development in the Gulf countries.
Effective leadership and cohesion of the Execution team.
Contribution to business development and local market presence.
Maintaining high standards of operational excellence, safety, and compliance.
Hands-on and pragmatic leader with a proactive attitude.
Strategic thinker with a focus on operational execution.
High level of cultural sensitivity and adaptability.
PMP or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply (CIPS) certification is preferred.
